beats.event: War hero home from combat, dating Kay, outside the family business
Father Vito is shot in the street by Sollozzo's men
Volunteers to kill Sollozzo and a corrupt police captain
Murders both men in a Bronx restaurant
Exiled to hide in Sicily, cut off from Kay and home
Falls in love with and marries the Sicilian girl Apollonia
Apollonia killed by a car bomb meant for him
Learns brother Sonny was gunned down on the causeway
Returns to America, hardened, to succeed his father
Marries Kay to build a legitimate façade
Takes over as Don after Vito's death in the garden
Orders coordinated murders of all family enemies
Has his brother-in-law Carlo strangled for betraying Sonny
Lies to Kay's face about the killings
Sits alone in power; the man he was is gone
